patch.summary: Sellfy migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to Sellfy by inventorying legacy ecommerce fields, mapping them to Sellfy objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating critical integrations before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Confirm live plan limits on sellfy.com
Success signal: primary workflow works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: Sellfy migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power revenue workflows and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into Sellfy; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate primary integrations; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Creators selling digital products outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Confirm live plan limits on sellfy.com
If Sellfy mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Shopify before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire systems of record in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.
